title: Review access and tools each quarter

steps.do: For each connection, compare the scopes each person and agent role holds with what its work used this quarter, and remove what was not used.
Check that every person who left and every retired agent role has no remaining access, and revoke what remains.
Check MFA, credential rotation dates and the last tested restore of the venture's records, and prepare a decision for anything that needs wider access, a paid plan or new terms.
Compare the connections with the spend register and flag any paid tool with no connection or no use, proposing cancel, downgrade or keep for the founder.
Propose the order of this quarter's IT fixes to the product lead, worst exposure first.

done_criteria.check: Does every agent role hold its own credential with no scope it did not use this quarter, and is every widening open as a decision for the founder?
